item.description: Beyond 1st Level As your character goes on adventures and overcomes challenges, he or she gains experience, represented by experience points.

item.description: Inspiration Inspiration is a rule the game master can use to reward you for playing your character in a way that’s true to his or her personality traits, ideal, bond, and flaw.
